boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-purchase Aztec Nights activities listed by SDSU Associated Students. A valid SDSU RedID is required for Aztec Nights attendance.

cards.title: Join First Night Fest
cards.subtitle: Campanile Walkway · Aztec Nights
cards.notes: Bring your SDSU RedID and meet at Campanile Walkway for Playfair activities, live music, crafts, inflatables, and a photo booth.
cards.short_summary: A campus welcome-night program with multiple social activities.
cards.evidence_claim: SDSU lists First Night Fest as an Aztec Nights event with free food, live music, interactive inflatables, crafts, and a photo booth.
cards.access_notes: Aztec Nights is described by Associated Students as free late-night fun; a valid SDSU RedID is required for students to attend.

cards.entity_name: Ballads and Burgers: A Returning Student Experience
cards.title: Catch Ballads and Burgers
cards.subtitle: Goldberg Courtyard · Aztec Nights
cards.notes: Use your SDSU RedID to join the returning-student event in Goldberg Courtyard for dueling pianos, a DJ, and a block-party setting.
cards.short_summary: A returning-student welcome event centered on live music.
cards.evidence_claim: SDSU lists Ballads and Burgers as an Aztec Nights event with live dueling pianos, a DJ, free food, and a block-party atmosphere.
cards.access_notes: Aztec Nights is described by Associated Students as free late-night fun; a valid SDSU RedID is required for students to attend.

cards.title: Make a Campanile Kickback
cards.subtitle: Campanile Walkway · Aztec Nights
cards.notes: Bring your SDSU RedID for the Campanile Walkway event; try the lawn games or Human Bingo and use the photo booth with friends.
cards.short_summary: A Campanile Walkway social with games and conversation starters.
cards.evidence_claim: SDSU lists Campanile Kickback as an Aztec Nights event with a live DJ, mini golf, lawn games, a photo booth, coloring, trivia, and free food and drinks.
cards.access_notes: Aztec Nights is described by Associated Students as free late-night fun; a valid SDSU RedID is required for students to attend.

cards.title: Play at ARC After Dark
cards.subtitle: Aztec Recreation Center · Aztec Nights
cards.notes: Bring your SDSU RedID to the ARC for group games, mini golf, Nintendo Switch play, basketball challenges, and interactive inflatables.
cards.short_summary: An evening of recreation activities inside the Aztec Recreation Center.
cards.evidence_claim: SDSU lists ARC After Dark as an Aztec Nights event with interactive inflatables, mini golf, giant games, Nintendo Switch gaming, and basketball challenges.
cards.access_notes: Aztec Nights is described by Associated Students as free late-night fun; a valid SDSU RedID is required for students to attend.

cards.subtitle: Campanile Walkway · Aztec Nights

cards.evidence_claim: SDSU lists SoCal Dreamin’ as an Aztec Nights event with a surf simulator, interactive games, crafts, a photo booth, and a live DJ.
cards.access_notes: Aztec Nights is described by Associated Students as free late-night fun; a valid SDSU RedID is required for students to attend.
